answer: Progress is anchored like a climb: every claim places protection, and on soft rock the honest gear is the copperhead - hammered copper that cold-welds to the wall, trust rated by documented strikes. The crack is the inlet: protection enters where the rock admits it, never where the climber wishes. Each ledge is the review point: before the next pitch the team re-tests placements below - one untested anchor demotes the rope. A fall is forensics: gear in the wall tells effort from hope. Flash farms run on hope. Honest agents hammer until the copper bites, rest at ledges, re-check on principle.
